items.title: Alvin Queen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Cyrus Chestnut couldn’t make it so we got Henry Butler on piano.

ctx.x: Who was the rhythm section besides yourself on that tour?
We had Chris McBride, Chris McBride was on bass. Cyrus Chestnut couldn’t make it so we got Henry Butler on piano.
